instrument: Directive on Security Management, Appendix J: Standard on Security Categorization (TBS)
what_it_says (short/paraphrased): Classified = Confidential / Secret / Top Secret (injury to the national interest). Protected A / B / C = injury outside the national interest; Protected B example includes loss of reputation or competitive advantage; Protected A example: an exact salary figure. In effect 2019-07-01.

instrument: Guide on the use of generative artificial intelligence (TBS) - guidance, not a directive
what_it_says (short/paraphrased): Public servants must not input personal information into publicly available online generative AI tools. Do not enter sensitive or personal information into tools not managed by the GC. Seek the institutional chief security officer's approval before using generative AI for protected or other sensitive information. Applies to federal institutions; applicability to NCC unconfirmed.

instrument: CanadaBuys award notices open dataset (PSPC / Open Government Portal)
what_it_says (short/paraphrased): CSV award notices, Open Government Licence - Canada, updated daily, 2012 to present, federal organizations incl. Crown corporations subject to trade agreements. Fields include contractAmount (incl. taxes), totalContractValue, supplier, procurementCategory (CNST), regionsOfDelivery, procurementMethod, selectionCriteria, UNSPSC/GSIN. No bids-received field.

Permits copying, modifying, publishing, distributing and using the information for any lawful purpose incl. commercial, with attribution ('Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada.'); excludes personal information, third-party rights and official marks; no implied endorsement; provided as is.
Only bingbot and Googlebot are named (crawl-delay 5; tender-notice and award-notice paths disallowed for them); every other user-agent: Disallow /. Do not crawl the site; use the open-data files.
Tender/award notices carry the Open Government Licence - Canada; related solicitation documents and/or tender attachments are copyright protected.
